KZ.title: To flood Sydney, the effects team didn’t rely on CGI or massive dump tanks. They built a hydraulic wave paddle directly into the miniature harbour—one mechanical push, one tsunami, one take. 🌊🎬 Watch closely as the water pulls away from the shoreline before the wave strikes. That’s real tsunami physics recreated in miniature. Then the Opera House takes the full impact… and even the Harbour Bridge can’t survive the backwash. CGI can imitate water—but nothing moves like the real thing. #BehindTheScenes #MovieMagic #Miniatures

They built a hydraulic wave paddle directly into the miniature harbour—one mechanical push, one tsunami, one take. 🌊🎬 Watch closely as the water pulls away from the shoreline before the wave strikes. That’s real tsunami physics recreated in miniature. Then the Opera House takes the full impact… and even the Harbour Bridge can’t survive the backwash.
